HeroName: Marie von Brabant, Countess of Louvain
Description: Marie von Brabant was Queen consort of France as the second wife of King Philip III. Renowned for beauty, intellectual brilliance, and political courage, she triumphed over vicious court slander engineered by royal favorites, exercising profound diplomatic influence between France and the Empire. Marie patronized scholars and poets in Paris, disproving treasonous court conspiracies with icy composure and ruling as an influential counselor beside King Philip III. She endowed perpetual relief funds at Notre-Dame in Paris, winning universal adoration from clergy and burghers as an unshakeable guardian of Franco-German peace. Exquisite and resolute, Queen Marie dismantled court slander with brilliant intellect, reigning beside King Philip III as an immortal guardian of justice. Throughout every bitter imperial diet, contested royal election, and shifting territorial campaign across the Rhineland and Low Countries, their relentless aristocratic dedication, strategic statecraft, chivalric discipline, steadfast valor, and immense personal resources preserve the sovereign dignity, mercantile wealth, and military supremacy of the Holy Roman Empire, safeguarding civic liberty, territorial integrity, and dynastic grandeur against every rival prince, papal league, and hostile coalition across Central Europe for future generations to inherit with pride, commanding profound imperial reverence from all subjects throughout Christendom and standing as an immortal beacon of chivalric honor, lawful constitutional governance, and sovereign peace across European civilization.
Motivations: Expose and crush treacherous cabals in the Parisian court, securing her royal authority.
Align French royal diplomacy to support her brother Johann I's annexation of Limburg.
Patronize troubadours and scholars in Paris, blending Low Countries arts with French court culture.
Values: Believes a royal queen must wield colder intellect than any courtier to survive palace intrigue.
Holds spotless honor sacred, purging slanderous favorites who seek to tarnish the crown.
Fears: Renewed poisoning conspiracies in Paris threatening the survival of her royal children.
Total war between France and the Holy Roman Empire tearing her loyalties apart.
SpeechStyle: Speaks with immaculate Capetian courtly elegance and razor-sharp intellect, regal and feared. Always fiercely defending Holy Roman imperial dignity, princely municipal liberties, and Low Countries territorial hegemony.
